headline: Approved multiple wetlands permits including 195 and 197 Atlantic Street and 84 Causeway Street, continued others, and ratified penalties for 137 Wingaersheek Road.
summary: The Commission approved several Notices of Intent with conditions, including projects at 195 Atlantic Street, 197 Atlantic Street, 84 Causeway Street, Keystone Road, 59 Leonard Street, 10 Dennison Street, and the Pole's Hill trail maintenance project. Several other applications were continued to future meetings, including 24 Kondelin Road, Tommy's Island, 12 Woodward Avenue, 18 Juniper Road, 7 Sumac Lane, 740R Washington Street, 49 Crafts Road, and 103 Essex Avenue. The Commission also issued negative determinations for sheds and dock removal projects, approved several Certificates of Compliance, and ratified administrative penalties against the owner of 137 Wingaersheek Road for failing to comply with an Enforcement Order.
